title: Robinhood Adds SkyFi Satellite Analytics to AI Agent App for Tracking Public Company Sites

tickers.name: Robinhood Markets, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Robinhood has launched a new tool allowing retail investors to monitor physical activity at facilities tied to publicly traded companies using satellite imagery. The service, provided by SkyFi, is integrated as an agent app within the Robinhood platform and uses an LLM interface to deliver imagery and analysis from BlackSky over corporate sites such as data center construction zones and vehicle manufacturing plants.

The application starts with coverage of 24 sites and costs $10 a month after a 30 day free trial. Users can query their AI agent about a specific location to receive the most recent satellite observations and data to inform their investment decisions.

@SkyfiApp's Satellite Intelligence, a @RobinhoodApp Agent App, is now available. 

BlackSky is the initial imagery provider for the app, which allows a Robinhood customer to ask their agent about physical activity at a fixed set of facilities, including vehicle plants, fulfillment centers, theme parks, and data center construction sites. 

SkyFi delivers the analytic results, which are derived from BlackSky satellite imagery captured within set time windows. For example, the imagery below shows the number of vehicles at the @Tesla factory in Austin. 

Check it out today: https://t.co/IRX7NzldaS
